Package com.bilt.pos.session.identity

Class Member

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.session.identity.Member
public final class Member extends Object
The member attached to a shopper session, as the POS provides it or as identification resolved it.

A member is in one of two states. Resolved: the Bilt member id is known — id(String) when the POS already has it, or what an identification reported (resolved(IdentifyResult)), which additionally carries the loyalty brand, rewards, and point balance the terminal returned. Pending resolution: the POS has an identifier the shopper is known by — an account id, phone number, email, or a retailer-specific value — and the session resolves it in the background once the member is attached: 


 session.member(Member.id("mbr_8f2a"));                              // attaches immediately
 session.member(Member.idResolver().phone("+12015550123"));          // resolved in the background
 session.member(Member.idResolver().accountId("4823").keyedByCashier());
 session.member(null);                                               // signed out

Immutable, with value semantics. toString() masks phone numbers and email addresses.
